additional_info.subject: JLKpZW - change config
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
During the commissioning charger JLKpZW was limited to 13kW, could we change this so it effectively delivers 20kW. Either 20kW on one outlet or 2x10kW?
Thomas

Troubleshooting

Seems that even after you left the problems haunt you :D
Let's align here what is best, if I limit the input power to 30kVA (approx 20kW), it might do more than 20kW since the only corresponding values we have is way above 20kW, but even here is only 10kW difference.
If you want, I can limit the outlets to 10kW each but then it will never give 20kW if you want to try it.
Let me know what is best for you.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0393805
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
